notes: ACCESS: direct fetch, no proxy needed (same as the prior Home-Decor pass). Shopify storefront 'bloomr-dubai.myshopify.com', country AE, currency AED, English default locale (/ar and /ru are sub-locales), so canonical English /collections/<handle> URLs were used. TREE: taken from the site's own mega-menu on the homepage. Bloomr has a single top-level 'Furniture' menu (the other top-level menus are Artificial Flowers & Orchids, Artificial Trees, Artificial Plants, Artificial Stems, Home Decor, Lighting, Bedlinen & Towels, Tableware, Rugs, Summer Sale - none of which contain furniture). The Furniture menu is a FLAT list of 17 children under 'ALL FURNITURE'; there is no intermediate grouping level, so all 14 in-scope nodes are leaves directly under the Furniture group row. COUNT METHOD (Rule 1): qty is the storefront's own rendered listing header, div id='ProductCount', e.g. '1-48 of 186 products'. The Shopify structured products_count was NOT used as the source. SANITY CHECKS: (a) every h1 matched the category requested and no redirect occurred (final URL == requested URL on all 14); (b) counts all differ from each other and from the site-wide/parent number, so no constant/site-total artefact; (c) last-page boundary proven - /collections/side-tables?page=4 renders '145-186 of 186' and ?page=5 renders zero tiles, /collections/sofas?page=2 renders '49-57 of 57', /collections/coffee-tables?page=4 renders '145-155 of 155', /collections/sideboards-cabinets?page=2 renders '49-95 of 95'; (d) independent enumeration via /collections/<h>/products.json?limit=250 returned exactly 56 (Beds), 10 (Display Units), 19 (Benches & Stools) and 95 (Sideboards & Cabinets), matching those headers exactly. PARENT NOT USED AS LEAF: /collections/furniture reports 799 products but has extractable children, so it is a grouping row per the URL-hierarchy rule (note the 14 children sum to 893 > 799 because Shopify collections cross-list; this is further proof the parent total is a real page total and not a sum). EXCLUDED: 'Concrete Furniture' (32), 'Marble & Stone Furniture' (162) and 'Wood & Rattan Furniture' (285) are the site's own MATERIAL filter collections cutting across the same catalogue as the product-type nodes above - excluded per the 'never extract material filter pages' rule, and including them would double-count. 'ALL FURNITURE' excluded as a View-All node. /collections/furniture-sale and /collections/furniture-outlet excluded as promo pages. /collections/coffee-side-tables and /collections/dining-tables-chairs exist in the sitemap but are non-nav parents of nodes already captured (Coffee Tables + Side Tables; Dining Tables + Dining Chairs) - dropped to avoid duplicating the deeper children. 'Mattresses' excluded as bedding per the brief (it sits under Bedlinen & Towels, not Furniture, and its page publishes no ProductCount header anyway). Also excluded: Bedlinen & Towels, Rugs, Home Decor, Lighting, Tableware and all artificial botanical ranges. ABSENCE CHECK for anything missed: the full collections sitemap (311 collections) was keyword-scanned for furniture/sofa/chair/table/bed/desk/cabinet/wardrobe/stool/bench/dresser/shelving/bookcase/seating/nightstand/armchair/ottoman/pouf/sectional/recliner/daybed/patio/outdoor/garden/sideboard/console/office/crib etc. - it surfaced no outdoor, office, kids, bathroom-vanity, wardrobe or bookcase collections, so Bloomr genuinely has no such ranges.
